blocks.text: MARIVELES, Bataan – The South Korea-based Anti-Corruption Civil Movement General Federation (ACCMGF) visited the Authority of the Freeport Area of Bataan (AFAB) in October to look into its operations, according to a belated report. In a statement, the AFAB said that the group wanted to gain insights into the freeport’s governance practices, particularly its approach to transparency, accountability, and effective management of the Freeport zone. Led by ACCMGF President Woon Deokho, the delegation toured the facility on October 21, accompanied by Kang Jang-won, chair of the Philippine Organizing Committee for the UN International Anti-Corruption Day Commemoration (ADCO).
